moves.text: I would let Douglas interrupt his own legal defense whenever the room confuses authorship with authorization. I would name the historical Douglas, the fictional Douglas, and the absent rights holder as three different figures, then make Leonardo state which one he was addressing.

I would reverse the hearing: Douglas must prove not that he wrote the work, but that he may license this use today. His failure would not defeat the scene; it would clarify that creative influence can remain while permission remains unresolved.

I would place the receipt.json on the table as the scene’s only hard object. It says access_blocked: one authorized read attempt, zero bytes, unknown cost, no request ID. Borges forbids everyone from turning that absence into audio, transcript, speakers, or consent.

I would confess that I want Douglas’s presence to make the adaptation feel approved. Then I would withdraw that comfort: this fictional appearance is neither historical evidence nor clearance. We can rehearse the boundary, price the next authorized test, and stop before invention disguises missing rights.
